plugins.name: consort
plugins.description: Consort: a Spec-First Branched-Database TDD agent framework. Run /consort:start to launch the workflow (resumes in a scaffolded project, guides creation elsewhere). A deterministic orchestrator (lakebase-sftdd-drive) spawns the role agents (product-owner, spec-author, architect-reviewer, dba, test-strategist, ux-designer, navigator, driver) and holds human-in-the-loop gates.
